s: About what share of India's trade by value is carried by sea?
x: Sea routes carry about 95% of India's trade by volume but only about 70% by value (Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways / PIB).

s: How many non-major ports does India have?
x: India has 12 major and 217 non-major ports; sea routes carry ~95% of its trade by volume and ~70% by value.

s: In which year was the agreement establishing the New Development Bank signed?
x: The NDB agreement was signed at the 6th BRICS Summit, Fortaleza, in July 2014; the bank opened in Shanghai and began operations in 2015.

s: In which year was the New Development Bank agreement signed, and where is the bank headquartered?
x: The NDB agreement was signed at Fortaleza in 2014 (operations from 2015); the bank is headquartered in Shanghai and led by President Dilma Rousseff.

s: When was the India–AI Impact Summit held in New Delhi?
x: The India–AI Impact Summit ran 16–20 February 2026 at Bharat Mandapam (leaders' segment 19–20 Feb; Expo extended to 21 Feb, when the New Delhi Declaration was adopted).

s: To what level were India–Italy ties elevated in 2026?
x: During PM Modi's visit to Italy (19–20 May 2026), India and Italy elevated ties to a Special Strategic Partnership (up from the 2023 Strategic Partnership).

s: In April 2026 the IMF projected India's FY27 growth at about what?
x: The IMF's April 2026 World Economic Outlook raised India's FY27 (2026-27) growth projection to 6.5%, from 6.4% in January; 6.2% was the October 2025 figure.

s: In January 2026 the IMF raised India's 2025-26 growth projection to what?
x: The IMF's January 2026 WEO Update raised India's 2025-26 growth to 7.3%; its April 2026 WEO put FY27 at 6.5%.

s: In which year did India leave the FGFA programme?
x: India joined the Indo-Russian FGFA (Su-57-based) programme in 2007 and pulled out in 2018 (reported 20 April 2018).

s: Who is the CEO of NITI Aayog?
x: Anurag Jain (1989-batch IAS) took charge as NITI Aayog CEO on 17 August 2026; Nidhi Chhibber had held additional charge after B.V.R. Subrahmanyam's term ended in February 2026.

s: Who is the Vice-Chairperson of NITI Aayog?
x: Ashok Kumar Lahiri was appointed NITI Aayog Vice-Chairperson in April 2026 (took charge May 2026), succeeding Suman Bery.

s: Who is the Vice-Chairman of NITI Aayog?
x: Ashok Kumar Lahiri became NITI Aayog Vice-Chairman in April 2026, succeeding Suman Bery (2022-26).

s: In which year was NITI Aayog set up?
x: NITI Aayog was set up on 1 January 2015 (HQ New Delhi); its Vice-Chairman is now Ashok Kumar Lahiri (from April 2026).

s: The 18th BRICS Summit theme expands which acronym?
x: The theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability' spells BRICS; the 18th Summit was held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, 12–13 September 2026.

s: Where is the headquarters of the New Development Bank located?
x: The New Development Bank is headquartered in Shanghai, China; its agreement was signed in 2014 (Fortaleza) and it began operations in 2015.

s: Which NITI Aayog Vice Chairman described QCOs as a 'malign intervention'?
x: Suman Bery (then NITI Aayog Vice Chairman) called QCOs a "malign intervention".

s: Telangana's Rachakonda police commissionerate was renamed what (2026)?
x: Rachakonda was renamed Malkajgiri (not the reverse); Future City is the new fourth commissionerate.
